objective: Using high-resolution Digital Elevation Models (DEM) and vegetation indices, map the optimal foraging corridors and flight zones for Apis mellifera originating from Goldstream Honeyworks. Specifically identify and rank 'south-facing bases' (solar aspect > 135° and < 225°) that provide maximum morning solar radiation for hive warming, and correlate these with high-density pollen/nectar vegetation zones.
constraints: Calculate the solar aspect and inclination from the DEM for the entire 3km radius.
Weight the foraging zones based on the soil moisture data generated in the previous task.
Define flight zones based on topographic wind shelters and direct line-of-sight to floral resources.
Output the optimal hive placement coordinates as a prioritized list.
